name: Mount Corrin
description: A bare grey mountain with a single path up it, where the bridges are older than the villages that use them.

foot.name: The Foot of the Path
foot.description: Scree and thin grass, and a signpost with the names scratched off. The path climbs north between two shoulders of grey rock. To the south the date palms of Dunhallow nod over the wall.

switchback.name: The Switchbacks
switchback.description: The path turns back on itself again and again, each turn a little steeper, the drop on the open side a little further. Something small has been scratching at the rock.

north.failure_message: A wall of blue ice fills the path from rock to rock, thick as a house. It does not look like weather.

bridge.name: The Rope Bridge
bridge.description: A narrow bridge of grey planks and old rope spans a gorge so deep the bottom is only a sound. It sways. Past it the path runs on to a shelf of rock.

ledge.name: The Wind Ledge
ledge.description: A shelf of rock under the summit, scoured by a wind that smells faintly of struck flint. Above, east, the path ends in a ring of black stone, and from it comes a slow, patient ticking.

east.failure_message: You step toward the black ring, and the ticking stops, listening.

summit.name: The Black Ring
summit.description: A ring of fused black stone at the top of the mountain, its floor crazed with burn marks. A road drops away north toward the walls of a city, and the air above it is full of smoke.

north.failure_message: The way down to Tolmere is past the thing that ticks. It will not let you by.
